configurationChanges: Pilot PostgreSQL DATABASE_URL and backup policy
Capability-gated Instagram Professional and LinkedIn organization credentials for explicitly approved pilot accounts
featureFlags: External publishing remains capability-gated and human-approval-bound
Production enablement remains unauthorized until a separate exact-SHA approval
smokeTests: Apply all 13 migrations to a clean pilot database and verify schema readiness
API live/ready health checks succeed after database initialization
Authenticated owner can open a Brand and traverse the primary web workflow
Brand-private reads remain tenant-isolated across two test Workspaces
Approved publishing succeeds when channel capability exists or degrades explicitly to manual fallback
Performance ingestion and Pilot Operations failure/retry paths remain observable
End-to-end smoke test runs against the exact certified SHA

rollbackStrategy.summary: Before release approval, verify a provider-specific rollback/forward-recovery runbook. Default safety response is to stop pilot traffic, disable external publishing automation, preserve audit state, restore the approved PostgreSQL backup or forward-recover migrations as appropriate, and redeploy the last approved certified SHA. No provider command is authorized until deployment topology is approved.
